svg.title: A Nested Licensee Development Funnel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-qualified-licensee-cohorts; chart type: funnel; title: A Nested Licensee Development Funnel; subtitle: One 200-account cohort; five progressively narrower evidence states.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative account counts across a 6–24-month development window, not a measured benchmark or a 30-day closing promise. Every later cohort is a subset of the preceding cohort. These counts do not derive the canonical annual revenue scenarios.; caption: Sequential conversion is 40%, 40%, 37.5%, and 41.67%; five executed licensees represent 2.5% of the original cohort.; stages: label: Screened accounts; value: 200 accounts with relevant commercial applications; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Each account has an identified product category, operating territory, and plausible use for the controlled rights.; label: Confirmed use cases; value: 80 accounts with documented buyer interest; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Eighty of 200 accounts confirm a specific application and identify a contact responsible for evaluating the rights.; label: Diligence participants; value: 32 accounts exchanging technical and rights evidence; numeric value: 32.0; detail: Thirty-two of 80 accounts review the rights package and supply enough product information to assess licensing fit.; label: Negotiated term sheets; value: 12 accounts negotiating scope and economics; numeric value: 12.0; detail: Twelve of 32 accounts negotiate permitted uses, minimum guarantees, royalty bases, and reporting capabilities.; label: Executed licensees; value: 5 accounts with signed reporting obligations; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Five of 12 negotiating accounts execute agreements. Track invoicing, collection, and revenue recognition separately.

circle.title: label: Screened accounts; value: 200 accounts with relevant commercial applications; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Each account has an identified product category, operating territory, and plausible use for the controlled rights.

label: Confirmed use cases; value: 80 accounts with documented buyer interest; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Eighty of 200 accounts confirm a specific application and identify a contact responsible for evaluating the rights.

label: Diligence participants; value: 32 accounts exchanging technical and rights evidence; numeric value: 32.0; detail: Thirty-two of 80 accounts review the rights package and supply enough product information to assess licensing fit.

label: Negotiated term sheets; value: 12 accounts negotiating scope and economics; numeric value: 12.0; detail: Twelve of 32 accounts negotiate permitted uses, minimum guarantees, royalty bases, and reporting capabilities.

label: Executed licensees; value: 5 accounts with signed reporting obligations; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Five of 12 negotiating accounts execute agreements. Track invoicing, collection, and revenue recognition separately.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative account counts across a 6–24-month development window, not a measured benchmark or a 30-day closing promise. Every later cohort is a subset of the preceding cohort. These counts do not derive the canonical annual revenue scenarios.
